newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Biber to hold news conference.
newsitem.headline: Biber to hold news conference.

text.p: Swiss paper maker Biber Holding AG, which has been in talks about selling its graphic paper business, said it would hold a news conference on December 17 on "important measures in the Biber group".
A Biber statement set the news conference for 0815 GMT.
A Biber spokesman, asked to elaborate on the subject of the news conference, noted that there had been lots of media and market speculation about a potential sale.
"We will inform you about the status of things as they are tomorrow morning. I cannot say more," he told Reuters.
The paper group has said it was considering a sale, partnership or capital increase to secure its future but that the option of a sale was most realistic.
Finland's Metsa-Serla said last week it was in talks on buying Biber's graphic paper business.
Biber has neither confirmed nor denied the Metsa-Serla statement and the spokesman on Monday said the group was in talks on various options with several interested parties.
"It will certainly be about negotions on a sale," he said about the news confernce.
Graphic or fine paper made up some two-thirds of Biber's 1995 sales which totalled 673 million Swiss francs.
The rest came mainly from newsprint, a business Metsa-Serla said it was not interested in.
Biber has posted mounting losses since 1991 and last year ended with a net loss of 322.6 million Swiss francs.
